title: 第894章 宁尘vs寂灭神王第893章 惊世一战
slug: 魔门送葬开局被女帝逆推
lines: 九天之上。
两道身影对峙，仅是从两人身上所流露出的一缕气息，仿佛都足以让寻常神王强者感到窒息。
这两人…可以说是当前整个上界战力巅峰也毫不为过。
“宁尘，你的确不一般。”
“就算只是寻常的九星神王，可所爆发而出的气势，却是能超越巅峰神王，甚至…给本神王的压力，都远远要比那洛苍要强的多。”
寂灭神王目光落在宁尘身上，说到这，他的语气似是有些惋惜，冷笑一声。
“不过可惜了。”
“若你能早出生一万年…哦不，哪怕只是一千年，恐怕今日结局都不会不一样。”
“今日…注定是以你失败而告终为结局。”
“是么？”
听到寂灭神王的话，宁尘神情平静，似是笑了笑，微微摇头：“若我早出生一千年，今日的结局也不会改写。”
“本神王倒以为你会更自信。”
寂灭神王眉头一挑。
“不，我的意思是…”
宁尘眯了眯眼睛，眼中闪过一抹精光，“若我早出生一千年，你早就死了，那还会有今日之事？所以…今日甚至连结局都不会有。”
听到这话，寂灭神王明显是愣了一下，过了好一会儿方才是回过神来，冷笑一声。
“呵呵…”
“你狂妄！”
“狂妄又如何？”
“年轻人不狂妄，又怎么能叫年轻人呢？”
宁尘从容不迫的笑了笑。
“既然如此，那自是要付出狂妄的代价！”
话音落下。
寂灭神王冷哼一声，只见其周身竟是浮现出那灰白之色的寂灭之息，其所过之处，天穹黯淡无比，空间已然在不断的崩碎。
接着。
其身形瞬间已然消失原地，紧接着瞬间出现在宁尘的身前，只见其一只带着毁灭法则气息的一拳，已是距宁尘面门不过三寸。
一拳落下。
时间与空间在这一刻仿佛尽数堙灭。
“毁灭法则么…”
“就只有你有？”
宁尘眼神微凝，身形并未有丝毫退缩，同样是运转毁灭法则，那毁灭之息在指尖凝聚，接着朝着那一拳点下。
两股毁灭法则的力量在这一刻碰撞。
周围方圆百万里的星辰在这一瞬黯淡，空间化作堙灭，仿佛被轰成虚无。
content_en:
Above the nine heavens.
The two figures were confronting each other, and just a breath of aura from the two of them seemed to be enough to suffocate the average God King.
These two people...it is no exaggeration to say that they are at the peak of the entire upper realm's combat power.
"Ning Chen, you are indeed extraordinary."
"Even if he is just an ordinary nine-star god king, the momentum he can erupt can surpass that of the peak god king. Even... the pressure on this god king is far stronger than that of Luo Cang."
The God King of Annihilation's eyes fell on Ning Chen. When he said this, his tone seemed to be a little regretful and he sneered.
"But it's a pity."
"If you could have been born ten thousand years earlier...oh no, even if it was only a thousand years, I'm afraid the outcome today would not be different."
"Today...is destined to end with your failure."
"Really?"
After hearing the words of the God King of Annihilation, Ning Chen looked calm, seemed to smile, and shook his head slightly: "If I had been born a thousand years earlier, today's ending would not have been changed."
"Oh?"
"I thought you would be more confident."
The God King of Annihilation raised his eyebrows.
"No, I mean..."
Ning Chen squinted his eyes, and a glint flashed in his eyes, "If I had been born a thousand years earlier, you would have died long ago. What would have happened today? So... there won't even be an ending today."
"..."
Upon hearing this, the God King of Annihilation was obviously stunned for a moment. It took a while before he came back to his senses and sneered.
"Haha..."
"You are arrogant!"
"So what if you are arrogant?"
"If young people are not arrogant, how can they be called young people?"
Ning Chen smiled calmly.
"If that's the case, then you have to pay the price for your arrogance!"
The words fell.
The God King of Nirvana snorted coldly, and saw the gray-white breath of Nirvana emerging from his body. Wherever it passed, the sky was extremely dim, and the space was constantly collapsing.
then.
His figure disappeared in an instant, and then appeared in front of Ning Chen. His punch, which carried the aura of the Law of Destruction, was no more than three inches away from Ning Chen's face.
A punch landed.
Time and space seemed to be extinguished at this moment.
"The Law of Destruction..."
"Are you the only one who has it?"
Ning Chen's eyes were slightly focused, but his figure did not flinch at all. He was also operating the Law of Destruction, and the breath of destruction condensed on his fingertips, and then he pointed towards the punch.
boom…!
The two powers of destruction collided at this moment.
The surrounding stars with a radius of millions of miles dimmed at this moment, and the space was extinguished, as if it had been blasted into nothingness.
title_en: Chapter 894 Ning Chen vs God King of Annihilation Chapter 893 A shocking battle
